lab_questions.title: Consolidate Overlapping Employee Shifts
lab_questions.description:
An automated workforce scheduling system tracks employee work shift allocations as start and end hour intervals [start, end]. To calculate accurate total operational coverage for a store, HR needs to merge all overlapping or touching shift intervals into consolidated continuous blocks.

Read N (number of shift intervals), followed by N pairs of integers [start, end]. Print the merged shift intervals sorted by start time, each interval on a new line separated by a space.
